title: Centauri: Enabling Efficient Scheduling for Communication-Computation Overlap in Large Model Training via Communication Partitioning
problem: Communication bottlenecks in distributed LLM training with hybrid parallelism limit performance. Existing communication-computation overlap approaches rely on fine-grained kernel fusion or limited operation scheduling, constraining optimization in heterogeneous environments.
motivation: Overcoming communication bottlenecks through effective communication-computation overlap is critical for efficiently training large language models at scale.
method: Centauri introduces communication partitioning to enable efficient scheduling of communication-computation overlap. The approach partitions communication collectives within distributed partitioned graphs and schedules operations to overlap communication with computation. It supports multiple communication collectives and heterogeneous training environments.
key_novelty: Communication partitioning as a scheduling mechanism that decomposes collectives to enable finer-grained overlap between communication and computation.
contributions: Communication partitioning framework for distributed LLM training
Efficient scheduling methodology for communication-computation overlap
Support for multiple communication collectives in heterogeneous environments
Improvement over kernel fusion and limited operation scheduling approaches
limitations: Specific baselines and performance metrics not discussed in the abstract.
primary_theme: Communication-computation overlap scheduling in distributed training
